rungs.title: Depth timing: how long after the arm stops is depth reliable
rungs.note: frames taken while moving are ~10 mm off and no time shift fixes them; after the stop they are right at once; they arrive 150 ms (p90 650 ms) late. Rule: frames stamped >= 0.25 s after the TCP stopped (no fixed sleeps); immediate reads = reads 3 s later within 0.2 mm. Left: a 1-4 mm per-view bias

rungs.title: Depth tilt bias in the seat views
rungs.note: 10-21: same static base1 read by the 6-dof CAD fit from 12 views (top-down z0.52/0.60 x yaw 0/+-60, tilted 20/30 from +-x/-y; 0.9-1.3 mm rms each): xy spread median 2.1 max 5.1 mm, yaw 0.94 deg, z 6.5 mm; tilted views worst (y -439..-449). A rigid 6-dof mount correction does not help (leave-one-out 2.7 -> 2.7 mm): not a hand-eye offset - depth intrinsics or arm kinematics next. Until fixed: compare reads from the same view geometry, top-down certification only; the touch insert absorbs the residual. Top-down base views agree with the arm on tilt (base1 ~0.5 deg toward +x). Survey: ablations/logs/handeye_icp/20261021_200144. CLEARS AT: seated end heights within +-1 mm in every view.

rungs.title: Aim from the base markers in the SAME frame as the part
rungs.note: 10-22 00:13 CLEARED: u_brown seated by the pipeline on the free base1 (yaw 20 deg), no operator step - servo (same-frame marker pose, 2.5 mm over the rim) (4.3, 3.0) -> (0.1, 0.0) mm in one move, dip grid entered at (-0.5, +0.9) mm on dip 17 (same residual as by hand -> SERVO_BIAS), drive-mate seated, ExecuteMate placed=true; 9.5 min. | 10-21 23:50: u_brown seated on the free base1 (yaw 26 deg) by hand-driven observe->move->observe (scripts/manual_loop): base pose from its 2 visible markers in the hover frame (tilt from the chain, yaw searched, translation solved: 1.6 px, repeats 0.3 mm / 0.1 deg), part = its outline over bare table, one move (-4.6, 9.2) -> (0.0, -0.4) mm, then a 0.5 mm dip grid within 1.5 mm entered on dip 17/19, +1.06 mm of the seat at 6 N. The hover servo's target (CAD fit at 0.56 m projected at 0.29 m) carries hand-eye rotation error x 0.27 m: it reported 0.1 mm / 0.3 deg with the part ~5 mm / 2 deg off. NEXT: hover_servo uses the same-frame marker pose; free-base insert = the 0.5 mm dip grid (no spiral: 9 N carries the base, 1.5 N does not slide).
